name: 🌋Volcano Escape II [3.1.2]
desc:
Welcome to Volcano Escape II, a classic tower obby game of running from the rising lava!

The first time you play the game, you will be introduced to a tutorial. You can play on Practice Mode, where you can choose any map!

If you have Roblox Premium, you will gain increased V-cash, XP, and +1 extra⭐ on escape, stacking with VIP bonuses! You also get +1 daily Mystery Box!

This game is mostly inspired from Crazyblox's Flood Escape.
Game Version 3.6.2
